environment.description: Java 17 application deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (not ALB) with WebSocket passthrough enabled. The ELB performs TCP-level load balancing (Layer 4) with no HTTP-level inspection. No reverse proxy or API gateway sits between clients and the WebSocket endpoint. The application is directly internet-facing on port 443 with TLS termination at the ELB. Session cookies use SameSite=None for cross-domain compatibility with partner integrations. No rate limiting is configured at any layer.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP mode, port 443
